title: abutilon lucianum
intro: Abutilon lucianum, commonly known as the flame lily or orange flowered abutilon, is a flowering plant in the family Malvaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of fever, skin infections, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
